prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a hit while turning left in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1410; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather not give my name on a recording right now, if that's okay. You already have my claim information.
Q: Understood. Can you describe in your own words what happened at the intersection?
A: I was making a left turn at the light. I had a green arrow, I think, or at least the light was green for me. A vehicle coming straight through hit my driver's side front corner.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?
A: Not really. I looked, but it was already too close. I heard the horn and then there was a bang.
Q: How fast were you traveling when you started the turn?
A: Slow, maybe ten or fifteen miles an hour. I was waiting for a gap in traffic.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt?
A: Yes, I was.
Q: Did the airbags deploy?
A: The side curtain did, I think. Everything happened really fast.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the collision?
A: Yes. I went to urgent care that same afternoon. They said I have a concussion. I've had headaches, I get dizzy when I stand up, and the light bothers my eyes.
Q: Are you currently under a doctor's care for the concussion?
A: Yes, I have a follow-up scheduled and I've been told to limit screen time and rest as much as I can.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was trying to follow the rules of the road. I'm still dealing with the symptoms, so I may need some time before I can answer more questions.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
